en: A black‑and‑white multi-view postcard divided into four panels. The upper left panel shows a large wooden villa or lodge with a wide veranda, arched brick base, and surrounding greenery. The upper right panel shows a town street lined with two‑ and three‑storey houses; in the distance is woodland, and the printed word "Hamar" appears in the sky area. The lower left panel shows a broad street with early 20th‑century buildings and a few people with a cart. The lower right panel shows another long, straight street bordered by trees and multistory commercial buildings with signage on the facades.
